text_block_list.text:
The 2nd match of the Aoharu Cup Preseason! 
When I visit the waiting room—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Mmmghhh! Eko eko azarach, eko eko 
ottosei...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Come forth, gracious words that bring 
victory!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Where there is a will, there is a way"! I 
see! I'm sure everyone on the team will 
pull it off!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"So today's definitely gonna get a gold 
star! Let's stay confident and go for it, 
Trainer!"
